verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance-automation SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a vendor-hosted product: the API explorer runs on Sprinto's regional apps against the live tenant, and there is no on-prem or self-hosted deployment option. The open-source compliance-skills GitHub repo is an add-on agent skill, not the core product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
